Kyogre

Water

Hoenn · Generation 3 · Legendary Pokémon

Kyogre is a Water-type Sea Basin Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3), and is classed as a Legendary Pokémon. It stands 4.5 m tall and weighs 352 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (150), with a base stat total of 670.
